verdict.rationale: Raygun documents multi-select bulk actions in the Crash Reporting dashboard: you can tick several error groups and change their status together, and you can export all or selected error groups at once. This is UI-driven bulk handling for error triage only. There is no evidence of programmatic or AI-driven bulk operations; the MCP server is documented, but nothing shows it supports bulk actions. Missing for 10: bulk operations via API/MCP for AI-native workflows, bulk actions beyond status changes and export, documented limits or scale, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Select error group/s by clicking the checkbox in the list. Click the 'Change Status' dropdown that appears at the top of the list.
The Raygun Crash Reporting export feature allows customers to export all error groups or selected errors groups from within the Crash Reporting dashboard.
